public.behavior: Guest/member landing, product menus, responsive navigation, free-testing pricing and expandable questions.

legal.behavior: Retained legal text and date; desktop and mobile contents.

docs.behavior: Fourteen bundled guides and local search/results/no match/missing article; responsive navigation and contents. No remote article/search dependency.

auth.behavior: Single ambient auth card, password Show, validation, busy/errors, resend cooldown and Firebase repository handoffs.

account.behavior: Owner-scoped identity/profile updates, provider settings, usage facts, privacy handoffs and retention-aware signout.

support.behavior: Validated email handoff, topic selection, no-app/copy/manual-address fallback. No sent-ticket or completed-deletion claim.

system.behavior: Reusable loading/load-error/offline/unavailable/denied/not-found presentation. Mounted failure boundaries remain separately auditable.

projects.behavior: Project browser/search/empty/loading/trash/restore, stable create identity, options and conversation CAS rename/archive/restore.

workspace.behavior: Independent draft/viewer/request state, direct Make/Edit, automatic labels, exact phrase/custom alternatives/undo, deliberate reuse, durable result/text history and recovery. Embedded editor supports composer/history coexistence and timeline view preference; per-conversation owned draft menus replace the generic draft manager. Final read-only guard refuses draft edits for trashed/read-only projects,archived conversations and submitted drafts; viewer Use is disabled in read-only project/conversation state.

versions-viewer.behavior: Exact-version access, docked playback/Use/download/fullscreen, preferred/favourite distinction, actual lineage and pinned source frame extraction.

capabilities.behavior: Profile-driven editable/fixed/derived values; unavailable/error states and strict admission. Configured adapter presence is not output-quality qualification. Four mapped media profiles have pinned default cost ceilings against the existing Studio cap; native workflow text is unavailable unless a reviewed provider policy is supplied.

media-import.behavior: Fluid grid/search/filter/sort, empty/no match, hide/restore/copy, immediate fingerprint-bound resumable imports and matching-file recovery. Checking stays Uploading; success/cancel closes panel.

video-editor.behavior: CAS edit revisions; normalized exact-source 30fps preview; ordered clips/stills, trim/replace/reorder/remove/undo, framing, captions, separate audio, history and captured native FFmpeg export.

sketch.behavior: Drawing/erase/shapes/import, checkpoint restore, explicit start/pause/resume/retry/limit and exact displayed-output capture with deliberate use.

area-edit.behavior: Source/geometry-bound masks with drawing/erase/undo/redo/clear and Done. Current qualified models cannot submit area edits.

share.behavior: Exact-version publication/revoke, uncertain acceptance recovery, minimal public metadata and per-content-request ownership/project/epoch checks with HTTP Range.

email-external.behavior: Verification/reset mail is provider-owned outside the SPA; application states do not establish delivered email or console template parity.

remainingIssues.detail: Full and embedded editor views now coexist with composer/history. During alternate media inspection, actual EditorTimeline and Timeline control render through MediaViewer slots; playback pauses without unmounting edit state. Exact source insertion uses a retained operation receipt.
App mounts loading/load-error/offline; initial project errors map401/403 to denied,503 to unavailable,and offline transport to offline. Partial resource errors remain inline.
App retains SharedClip at /share/:uuid and routes new WorkflowSharePage at /share/media/:id; public lane captured the new namespace.

Generic remote-draft manager removed; owned per-conversation Drafts menu opens exact parked/open record with current retention guards. Host no longer supplies onCancel, so Stop is absent; native cancellation stays contract-only.

externalAcceptance: Live generation provider availability/output quality/spend qualification not exercised.
Firebase outbound mail delivery and provider-console template application remain external-owned.
Production Firestore index deployment, cloud FFmpeg environment/IAM/resource qualification and deployment not performed.
Current workflow adapters do not support area masks, end frames, reference-picture video or native extension; those offers are not faked.
Native workflow text actions (ask/expand-description/improve-words) fail closed without a reviewed provider/model spend policy; this is distinct from existing phrase suggestions.

validation.evidenceBoundary: Passing repository/provider-free journeys do not qualify live provider output, deployed cloud infrastructure, native OS save completion, Firebase mail delivery or exact visual acceptance for every retained frame. Earlier failed logs remain diagnostic history; confirmed logs above are the final gate result.

previousConfirmedSourceRun.note: Before the final narrow client read-only boundary correction; retained as history,not the latest result.

finalReadOnlyBoundary.scope: Client edit guard refuses trashed/read-only legacy project state,archived conversations and submitted drafts. Viewer Use is disabled in read-only project/conversation state. Routes,registration and backend unchanged; prior integration/browser evidence remains valid.
